policy.stale: 31-90 days; exclude from current-fact claims until reviewed
policy.expired: > 90 days; fixture/benchmark use only until re-verified
policy.unknown_or_invalid: do not use for selection without an explicit override
policy.cache_ttl_note: Manifest ttl is a client cache directive, not evidence that checked-in claims are fresh.
policy.url_note: 401/403/429 mean access_restricted, not dead. Only 404/410 are not_found.
